title: Mixxx: free Serato alternative
caption:
Serato DJ Pro charges $11.99/month to mix music like a DJ. Mixxx does it for free 🎧

✅ Finds the BPM and key of every track
✅ Sync matches tempo and beats for seamless mixing
✅ Effects like reverb and flanger, chained together
✅ Up to four decks, with built-in DJ controller support

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Mixxx works with just a laptop, but a DJ controller makes it feel like real decks. Serato's $11.99/month is DJ Pro on a monthly plan; it also sells DJ Pro for a one-time $299

Comment "MIX" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
